decisions.statement: A page type holds one line for every page property of that page type.
A line says what the page property's own page says and nothing more.
A line says whether the property keeps its values in the order they sort in.
A property saying nothing about that order says false here rather than nothing.
The lines are sorted by slug, so a property that changes moves one line.
Every page type extending `page-property` states this property.
A page type no page property is of holds a file with no line.
Every page type's file is written again when any page property changes.

definition: what every page property of a page type is, one line to a property
